# R packages used by the analysis scripts. This list includes packages outside renv.lock.
# CRAN
data.table, dplyr, tidyr, tibble, stringr, readr, ggplot2, ggrepel, patchwork, pheatmap,
shadowtext, systemfonts, Matrix, optparse, R.utils, future, RhpcBLASctl, readxl, openxlsx,
arrow, DBI, RSQLite, coloc, harmony

# Bioconductor
edgeR, limma, DEqMS, preprocessCore, SummarizedExperiment, GenomicRanges, rtracklayer,
ensembldb, EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86, BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38

# Single-cell / chromatin
Seurat, SeuratObject, Azimuth, BPCells, ArchR

# R 4.5 was used for the single-cell work (the cohort annotation directory carried an
# renv library for linux-rocky-9.8, R-4.5, x86_64-pc-linux-gnu). The renv library itself
# is not deposited; only the lockfile-relevant package set is recorded here.
# Model training and association testing (sections 03-04)
glmnet, sqldf, ACAT

# TF motif logos
JASPAR2024, TFBSTools, ggseqlogo

# Differential expression, public-cohort re-analysis and enrichment
DESeq2, TCGAbiolinks, enrichR, remotes

# Figure assembly
scales, gridExtra, png
